portfolio_rule: SPY above 200-day SMA: <=75% gross non-BIL; otherwise <=35%; estimate trailing-20-day portfolio annualized volatility, target <=30%, cap each non-BIL name <=35%, put residual in BIL. No borrowing.
selection_basis: Best observed return-to-drawdown balance among predeclared variants tested on 2025-11-11 through 2026-11-09; selection made AFTER seeing returns, NOT a validation or out-of-sample proof.

rejected_thematic_v3.reason: FNGU/FNGD pair did not improve one-year historical results under tested variants

research_limits: Backtest uses Yahoo Finance adjusted daily closes, idealized fills and 5bps per-unit-turnover transaction cost; not real broker fills.
Composer parity and original strategy's extraordinary simulated returns are unverified.
2025-2026 test is retrospectively observed; a true untouched out-of-sample period is still necessary.
A historical drawdown under 50% cannot guarantee a live drawdown under 50%.
No broker credentials, no trade orders, no scheduled workflows. No A15 or FSupertrend changes.
